decisions.reason: Although the accelerator program is less core and likely less capital-intensive than the machinery products, it was put on the home page and fits the firm's public circular-innovation narrative, so management would be inclined to continue it unless weakness becomes unmistakable.

As a flagship product tied to the firm's stated future direction, the bio-based binder carries strong public commitment and probable R&D investment, which makes escalation of commitment likely even if early market traction is uneven.

This decontamination plant is close to the firm's core offer, was prominently promoted on the home page with a high-visibility launch message and partners, and is therefore the kind of product management is especially likely to persist with.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is near the firm's established business and was visibly launched on the home page, so in a growing firm and industry management would likely keep backing it and interpret any early shortfalls as temporary.
